decisions.title: Consumer identifiers and US snapshot revision selection
decisions.recommendation: Accept the specified validated 12/13/zero-filled-14 scope, restricted ranges and conservative tie/date/discontinued holds; defer eight-digit and packaging codes.

decisions.title: Keyless read-only USDA index
decisions.recommendation: Implement the versioned server SQLite artifact and bounded typed POST lookup; keep activation gated on artifact delivery, total function size, Preview behavior and shared rate limiting.

decisions.title: Exact generic suggestions and correction
decisions.recommendation: Approve the 16 source-revision candidates for 11 existing identities; keep 29 holds and all unreviewed products manual. Confirm every addition; no component ownership or private metadata.

decisions.title: Owner-safe confirmation and camera fallback
decisions.recommendation: Implement typed confirmation first, then lazy ZXing UPC-A/EAN-13 capture, independent default-off controls, privacy limits and existing owner-bound persistence; require launch-device verification before camera activation.

approval_note: Documentation merge, CI and code review do not approve these product/technical decisions or activate lookup/camera.
